conventions.verticalAxis: Z, matching the existing 2D X-Z model
conventions.elementAxis: local x points from start to end; local y = normalize(vecxz cross local x); local z = local x cross local y
conventions.loads: force and moment are global nodal vectors; omitted components are zero
conventions.supports: listed DOFs are fixed at zero; omitted DOFs are free
conventions.reactions: positive reactions act from support onto structure, in global axes
conventions.beamTheory: small-displacement linear Euler-Bernoulli bending, linear axial strain, Saint-Venant torsion; no shear deformation, P-delta, self weight, or releases

sources.axes: McGuire, Gallagher & Ziemian, Matrix Structural Analysis, 2nd ed., ch. 4 (3D transformation)
sources.beam3d: McGuire, Gallagher & Ziemian, Matrix Structural Analysis, 2nd ed., ch. 5 (3D frame element)

cases.purpose: 3D direction cosines and axial stiffness without spurious bending
cases.derivation: L=3 m, n=(2/3,2/3,1/3), F=9000 N parallel to n. u_parallel=FL/(EA)=9/700000 m; u_global=u_parallel*n.

cases.purpose: different Iy and Iz, both transverse bending signs, support shear and moments
cases.derivation: Local axes equal global axes. uy=Fy L^3/(3 E Iz), uz=Fz L^3/(3 E Iy), ry=-Fz L^2/(2 E Iy), rz=Fy L^2/(2 E Iz). Reaction moment = -(r_AB cross F_B).

cases.purpose: Saint-Venant torsion on a skew beam and global rotation transform
cases.derivation: L=5 m, n=(0,3/5,4/5), T=1000 N m parallel to n. Twist = TL/(GJ)=0.0125 rad; rotation_global=twist*n.

cases.purpose: two-element assembly, pinned/roller supports, equal reactions and mirror symmetry
cases.derivation: Span L=4 m, downward P=1000 N. uz(M)=-PL^3/(48 E Iy)=-1/1260 m; vertical reactions P/2 each. rx(A) is fixed solely to remove the unloaded torsional rigid mode.
